meta.scope: Reconcile S105 recruited and analyzed populations and waveform-level evaluation with the IOP Version of Record

records.title: Feature extraction and prediction of spinal cord stimulation evoked compound action potentials in humans

searches.query: 10.1088/1741-2552/adbfbe recruited versus selected participants sessions and waveform cross-validation

updates.датасет: Fifteen chronic-pain participants recruited; 30 sessions from eight participants with externalized two-lead SCS selected, followed by exclusion of two sessions from one participant for uncertain electrode alignment
updates.ограничения: Eight selected participants out of 15 recruited and 28 retained sessions after two exclusions. Nested k-fold classification selected every 11th waveform per outer loop; no participant-held-out evaluation or external cohort. Underlying data are available only on author request subject to ethics/IRB restrictions. ECAP classes and features are neural-response measures, not pain or treatment outcomes.

evidence.population: Fifteen recruited adults with chronic pain; eight contributed 30 selected recording sessions, of which two were excluded for uncertain electrode alignment.

validation.notes: IOP Version of Record checked through text rendering of the official publisher PDF URL after direct IOP GET returned a Radware CAPTCHA. Methods 2.2 p. 3: 15 recruited, 30 sessions from eight selected, two sessions excluded. Methods 2.7 p. 5: outer cross-validation selects every 11th waveform, not a held-out participant. Table 1 p. 8: AUC median d-prime 2.44 for ECAP versus non-ECAP. Data availability p. 15: author request subject to ethics/IRB restrictions. No patient-level clinical pain outcome or independent validation.
